name: Barbell Seated Twist
steps: Sit tall astride a bench with feet planted firmly and rest a light barbell comfortably across your upper back.
Brace your abs and lock your hips squarely facing forward.
Rotate your chest and the bar smoothly a modest distance to one side using your obliques.
Return steadily through center and twist to the opposite side, alternating sides on each repetition.
tips: Decelerate the bar smoothly before the end of each turn rather than letting momentum swing your spine.
Keep your hips anchored firmly on the bench so the twist stays controlled in your torso.
